leads.title: Article 338 of Algerian law (English translation)
leads.documents: Documents criminal penalty for homosexual act: 2 months to 2 years imprisonment and 500 to 2000 Algerian Dinars fine; up to 3 years and 10,000 dinars fine for older participant if one participant is below 18
leads.detail: Cited in text as "Article 338 of Algerian law (English translation)" with full quoted text; no URL visible

leads.title: Article 333 of Algerian law (English translation)
leads.documents: Documents penalty when outrage to public decency consisted of an act against nature with individual of same sex: 6 months to 3 years imprisonment and 1,000 to 10,000 Algerian Dinars fine
leads.detail: Cited in text as "Article 333 of the Algerian law (English translation)" with full quoted text; no URL visible
